subject: Remove legacy SERVER_TEST compiler flag from cmake. (#1530)
reason: The change only deletes the obsolete SERVER_TEST=1 compile definition from the unit-test CMakeLists.txt. It is a build-system cleanup affecting only how unit tests are compiled; no server, command, replication, persistence or tool code changes, so the runtime binaries the fuzzer exercises are identical on both builds and no scenario can reach the change.
